children: UK engineered electronics firm's H1 organic revenue fell 2.7% yr/yr, but grew 4% excluding one-offs
Adjusted operating profit rose 37% yr/yr, driven by operational improvements and cost reduction
Company expects FY2026 adjusted operating profit to be ahead of company-compiled market expectations
Company expects revenue to return to organic growth in H2 2026, supported by strong order book
Full-year cash conversion expected in the range of 70–80%, supporting further deleveraging
OPERATIONAL ACTIONS - Improved profitability and margin expansion attributed to turnaround of Cleveland facility and closure of Plano site
COST REDUCTION - Substantial completion of cost reduction programme, with expected net savings during 2026
ORDER INTAKE - Strong order intake across divisions, supported by sales transformation initiatives
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the electronic equipment & parts peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for TT electronics PLC is GBp145.00, about 7.4% above its September 1 closing price of GBp135.00
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
